prs.title: [diffusion] Batch serial CFG for Qwen-Image to reduce denoising overhead
prs.summary_zh: 将 Qwen-Image 的 CFG 条件/无条件两次前向合并为单次 batched forward，减少每步 denoising 的重复 launch 开销。
prs.evidence_zh: [03-12 08:39:16] Peak GPU memory: 63.26 GB, Peak allocated: 61.10 GB, Memory pool overhead: 2.17 GB (3.4%), Remaining GPU memory at peak: 77.14 GB. Components that could stay resident (based on the last request workload)；[03-12 08:39:16] Me
